issues.description: The problem statement requires a Bookstore initializer with signature init(books: [Book]) but the solution's Bookstore implementation declares init() (no parameters) and attempts to use an undefined 'books' parameter. This mismatch prevents the code that constructs a Bookstore using Bookstore(books: books) from compiling and confuses students about the expected constructor signature.
issues.suggestedFix: Modify the Bookstore initializer in Sources/BookstoreLib/Bookstore.swift to match the specification: declare init(books: [Book]) and assign the parameter to the stored property (self.books = books). This will align the solution with the problem statement and allow Client code that calls Bookstore(books: books) to compile.
